chapter: Jelly Roll Morton and other records
title: Records with Jimmy O'Brien, a singer and possibly Ida Cox
summary: He vaguely recalls recording with a clarinetist named O'Brien and with blues singers, but cannot identify them.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: And I don't think I ever heard any of them records. Never even heard of them. Well, they're great. Yeah. Well, you know, I...I...I...I went...I made some recordings with...let's see, with someone else too, that...a little clarinet player. I can't think of the outfit we were with, though. O'Brien, I think it was Jimmy O'Brien. Oh yeah, Jimmy O'Brien.
I think it was...I made some...made a recording with some singer. I don't know...I don't know what...what the...the recordings were. Yeah. I believe it was...I believe Maureenie.

Oh really? I believe Maureenie was... I might have been. I'll have to listen. I have most of those Maureenie records. I...I...I believe...I believe it was Maureenie. There was Maureenie. There was some of Ida Cox too...된 you ever work with her...Ida Cox...
